response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled Staff/Senior Software Engineer with impressive technical depth in distributed systems, high-throughput microservices, and software craftsmanship. However, he fundamentally lacks the executive leadership background, the track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, and the deep production experience in algorithmic fintech and multi-agent AI systems required for this CTO position.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building high-throughput distributed systems and microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Strong dedication to software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD, and trunk-based development.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
concerns: No executive engineering leadership experience or demonstrated history of scaling teams and managing external delivery partners.
Lacks substantial production experience operating complex multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes commercial environments.
Missing deep domain expertise in algorithmic working-capital management, real-time credit risk, or core fintech infrastructure.
